comment: The summary of a feed incident, in the text template notation that jets/agentic/template compiles. This file is the one copy; it is embedded in jets/agentic/feedsummary and compiled when the package is first used. Its document is built by feedsummary.Document from a feedsummary.Input, which holds numbers, dates and closed vocabularies and nothing read from a delivery's rows. Every property a predicate tests is either a word from a closed list or the marker 'yes', present only when true, so an absent property and a false one read the same.

elements.comment: The headline: which feed, what happened, when it was found. The two loci are the only two a feed incident can sit at, and Validate refuses any other.
elements.text: {{if Locus == 'delivery_overdue'}}Feed {{Feed_Table}} is overdue{{end}}{{if Locus == 'delivery_departs_profile'}}A delivery of feed {{Feed_Table}} departs from the feed's declared profile{{end}}{{if Feed_Configured != ''}} (client {{Feed_Client}}{{if Feed_Org != ''}}, org {{Feed_Org}}{{end}}, object type {{Feed_Object_Type}}, {{if Feed_Cumulative != ''}}a cumulative feed{{end}}{{if Feed_Cumulative == ''}}an incremental feed{{end}}){{end}}. Found on {{Detected_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}.

elements.comment: A feed no source configuration names has no client and no declaration, and the summary says so rather than leaving the two paragraphs that need them silent.
elements.text: No source configuration names this table, so no client can be named for the feed and no declaration could be read for it.

elements.comment: Some deployments register deliveries under a placeholder client. The feed is attributed by table name, and the reader is told so before reading a client they will not find on the registration.
elements.text: The delivery is registered under client {{Registered_Under}}, not the feed's own; it is attributed to the feed by its table name.

elements.comment: What departed from what. One sentence per finding, worded by its detector, with the declared or expected bound beside the measurement. A finding whose numbers could not be read back says so rather than being dropped.
elements.empty: No finding at this locus could be read back for this feed.

elements.text: {{each has_Findings[] sep: ' ' last: ' '}}{{if Parsed == ''}}The {{Detector}} check fired; what it measured could not be read back as a number.{{end}}{{if Parsed != ''}}{{if Detector == 'feed_overdue'}}No delivery has arrived since the one for the period starting {{Observed_Period|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{if Overdue_From != ''}}; under the declared cadence the next became overdue on {{Overdue_From|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{if Days_Overdue != ''}}, {{Days_Overdue|words}} {{Days_Overdue|plural: 'day'}} before this was found{{end}}{{end}}.{{end}}{{if Detector == 'delivery_size'}}The delivery is {{Observed_Text}} bytes{{if Below != ''}}, below the expected minimum of {{Min_Text}} bytes{{end}}{{if Above != ''}}, above the expected maximum of {{Max_Text}} bytes{{end}}.{{end}}{{if Detector == 'delivery_backdated'}}The delivery is for the period starting {{Observed_Period|d_MMMM_yyyy}}, behind the latest period already delivered, which starts {{Bound_Period|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{if Periods_Behind != ''}}: {{Periods_Behind|words}} {{if Period_Word == 'month'}}{{Periods_Behind|plural: 'month'}}{{end}}{{if Period_Word == 'week'}}{{Periods_Behind|plural: 'week'}}{{end}}{{if Period_Word == 'day'}}{{Periods_Behind|plural: 'day'}}{{end}}{{if Period_Word == ''}}{{Periods_Behind|plural: 'period'}}{{end}} behind{{end}}.{{end}}{{if Detector == 'service_date_stale'}}The newest date of service is {{Observed_Text}} {{Unit}} behind the delivery's arrival{{if Unit == 'calendar months'}}, counted in calendar months because the delivery has few distinct members{{end}}; the declaration allows at most {{Bound_Text}} {{Bound_Unit}}.{{end}}{{if Detector == 'service_date_span'}}{{if Unit == 'days'}}The dates of service span {{Observed_Text}} days, newest less oldest; the declaration allows at most {{Bound_Text}} days.{{end}}{{if Unit == 'share'}}{{Observed_Text}} of the delivery's rows with a date of service are dated further before its newest date of service than the declared span; the declaration allows at most {{Bound_Text}}.{{end}}{{end}}{{if Detector == 'field_completeness'}}The required field {{Column}} carries a value in {{Observed_Text}} of the delivery's rows; the declaration requires at least {{Bound_Text}}.{{end}}{{if Detector == 'delivery_overlap'}}{{if Unit == 'share'}}{{Observed_Text}} of the delivery's distinct keys were already in the previous delivery; the declaration allows at most {{Bound_Text}}.{{end}}{{if Unit == 'keys absent'}}{{Observed_Text}} of the previous delivery's distinct keys are absent from this one, where a cumulative feed keeps every key it has sent.{{end}}{{end}}{{if Detector == 'delivery_unchanged'}}The delivery carries exactly the same business keys as the previous one.{{end}}{{end}}{{end}}

elements.comment: The cadence is what an overdue finding was owed against, so it is stated on that locus only. On the other locus each finding already carries its own bound.
elements.text: The declaration expects a delivery every {{if Periods_Per_Delivery > 1}}{{Periods_Per_Delivery|words}} {{end}}{{if Period_Word == 'month'}}{{Periods_Per_Delivery|plural: 'month'}}{{end}}{{if Period_Word == 'week'}}{{Periods_Per_Delivery|plural: 'week'}}{{end}}{{if Period_Word == 'day'}}{{Periods_Per_Delivery|plural: 'day'}}{{end}}{{if Overdue_After_Days != ''}}, with {{Overdue_After_Days|words}} {{Overdue_After_Days|plural: 'day'}} of grace{{end}}.

elements.comment: The ranked readings, best first, each with its confidence, its count of evidence for and against, and the grade its cause class has at this locus. A grade is printed as the ranker records it, so that a reader can find it on the hypothesis below.
elements.empty: No reading has been ranked for this incident.

elements.text: The readings, best first: {{each has_Readings[] sep: '; ' last: '; '}}{{Rank}}. {{if Cause == 'source_delivery_failure'}}the source did not send the delivery{{end}}{{if Cause == 'source_content_change'}}the source changed what it sends{{end}}{{if Cause == 'transformation_defect'}}the mapping lost or changed what the source sent{{end}}{{if Cause == 'benign_variation'}}an ordinary variation, or a declaration that no longer fits the feed{{end}}{{if Cause == 'transport_failure'}}the file was damaged or cut short in transit{{end}}{{if Cause == 'parse_failure'}}the file could not be read as declared{{end}}{{if Cause == 'validation_breach'}}the data failed a validation rule{{end}}{{if Cause == 'infrastructure_failure'}}the platform failed{{end}}{{if Cause == 'dependency_failure'}}something the feed depends on failed{{end}}{{if Cause == 'capacity_or_cost_deviation'}}a capacity or cost limit was reached{{end}} ({{Cause}}), confidence {{Confidence_Text}}, {{Supporting|words}} {{Supporting|plural: 'item'}} of evidence for and {{Contradicting|words}} against, graded {{Grade}} at this locus{{end}}.

elements.comment: The case against every reading: the declaration is what the delivery was judged against, so its author and its age are the first thing to doubt. This is the same item every feed hypothesis carries as contradicting evidence.

elements.text: The case against every reading: the profile this delivery was judged against was declared by {{Declared_By}}{{if Declared_At != ''}} on {{Declared_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{if Declared_After == ''}}, {{Declaration_Age_Days|words}} {{Declaration_Age_Days|plural: 'day'}} before this was found{{end}}{{if Declared_After != ''}}, after this was found; the profile has been declared again since, so this names the current declaration and not the one the delivery was judged against{{end}}{{end}}. The judgement is only as good as that declaration, and a departure from a declaration that no longer describes the feed is not a fault in the feed.
The case against every reading: the feed's profile can no longer be read, so who declared it and when cannot be given. Every reading rests on a declaration that cannot now be checked.

elements.comment: The feed condition this incident is the incident of: a run of consecutive deliveries of one feed with a finding at one locus, raised as one incident on its first delivery, which the later deliveries join. Which deliveries the incident holds is read through jets/agentic/feedcondition when the summary is read, by the rule shadow triage writes by, so the summary and the writer cannot disagree. It says how many deliveries the incident holds, from when to when, whether the condition is still open or how it ended, and the incident before it at the locus with its verdict, read now rather than from the incident's basis. Nothing here changes the record.

elements.text: The delivery's session id is not a time, so it has no place in the feed's order: this incident stands for this delivery alone, as a condition of one.

This incident stands for {{if Cond_Held == '1'}}one delivery{{end}}{{if Cond_Held != '1'}}{{Cond_Held|words}} deliveries{{end}} of the feed with a finding at this locus{{if Cond_Total != ''}}, of the {{Cond_Total|words}} in its condition{{end}}, registered {{if Cond_One_Day != ''}}on {{Cond_First|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{end}}{{if Cond_One_Day == ''}}from {{Cond_First|d_MMMM_yyyy}} to {{Cond_Last|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{end}}{{if Cond_Unregistered != ''}}{{if Cond_Held == '1'}}; it is a session with no registration of the feed{{end}}{{if Cond_Held != '1'}}; {{Cond_Unregistered|words}} of them {{if Cond_Unregistered == '1'}}is a session{{end}}{{if Cond_Unregistered != '1'}}are sessions{{end}} with no registration of the feed{{end}}{{end}}.{{if Cond_Shared != ''}} The session carries another feed's finding at this locus too, so it is a condition of one.{{end}}{{if Cond_Held > 1}} The findings above are those of the delivery the incident is written on; each other delivery's are on its own session.{{end}}{{if Cond_End == 'open'}} It is still open: the feed's latest delivery carries the finding.{{end}}{{if Cond_End == 'no_finding'}} It ended with the feed's next delivery, registered on {{Cond_Ended_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}, which carries no finding at this locus: that delivery was judged clean, or not judged.{{end}}{{if Cond_End == 'other_feed'}} It ended with the feed's next delivery, registered on {{Cond_Ended_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}, which carries another feed's finding at this locus too and is a condition of its own.{{end}}{{if Cond_End == 'day_boundary'}} It ends before the feed's next finding at this locus, registered on {{Cond_Ended_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}: both fall before the feed's earliest surviving registration and on different days, so the deliveries between them cannot be seen.{{end}}{{if Cond_End == 'verdict'}} It was closed by a person's verdict, {{Cond_Verdict}} on {{Cond_Verdict_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}: the condition's next delivery, registered on {{Cond_Ended_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}, was found after the verdict, so it is new evidence and not part of what was judged{{if Cond_Ended_Into != ''}}; it belongs to incident {{Cond_Ended_Into}}{{end}}{{if Cond_Ended_Into == ''}}; it has no incident yet{{end}}.{{end}}{{if Cond_End == 'next_incident'}} The condition goes on past it: its next delivery, registered on {{Cond_Ended_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}, {{if Cond_Ended_Into != ''}}belongs to incident {{Cond_Ended_Into}}{{end}}{{if Cond_Ended_Into == ''}}has no incident yet{{end}}.{{end}}{{if Cond_Same_Day != ''}} Part of the condition falls before the feed's earliest surviving registration, where two findings count as consecutive only when they were registered on the same day.{{end}}{{if Others_Text != ''}} Other deliveries of its condition belong to other incidents: {{Others_Text}}{{if Others_More != ''}} and {{Others_More|words}} more{{end}}.{{end}}{{if Cond_Unraised != ''}} {{if Cond_Unraised == '1'}}One delivery of its condition has no incident yet: it was found after a person's verdict on the incident before it, so it is new evidence.{{end}}{{if Cond_Unraised != '1'}}{{Cond_Unraised|words|sentence}} deliveries of its condition have no incident yet: they were found after a person's verdict on the incident before them, so they are new evidence.{{end}}{{end}}

{{if Prev_Kind == 'none'}}No earlier delivery of the feed carries a finding at this locus.{{end}}{{if Prev_Kind == 'after_verdict'}}It was opened after a person's verdict on incident {{Prev_Incident}}, earlier in the same condition, {{Prev_Verdict}} on {{Prev_Verdict_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}: this incident's first delivery was found after that verdict, so it is new evidence rather than part of what was judged.{{end}}{{if Prev_Kind == 'previous_condition'}}The feed's previous condition at this locus, {{if Prev_Deliveries == '1'}}one delivery{{end}}{{if Prev_Deliveries != '1'}}{{Prev_Deliveries|words}} deliveries{{end}} registered {{if Prev_One_Day != ''}}on {{Prev_First|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{end}}{{if Prev_One_Day == ''}}from {{Prev_First|d_MMMM_yyyy}} to {{Prev_Last|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{end}}, {{if Prev_Incident != ''}}has incident {{Prev_Incident}}, {{if Prev_Verdict != ''}}with a person's verdict, {{Prev_Verdict}} on {{Prev_Verdict_At|d_MMMM_yyyy}}{{end}}{{if Prev_Verdict == ''}}with no verdict{{end}}{{end}}{{if Prev_Incident == ''}}has no incident yet{{end}}.{{end}}
A condition is one fault that persists, raised as one incident: give it one verdict.
The same session carries findings on {{Other_Feeds|words}} other {{Other_Feeds|plural: 'feed'}} at this locus, which this summary does not describe.

elements.comment: Said every time, because a reader cannot otherwise tell a rendered summary from a drafted one.
elements.text: This summary is rendered from the incident's findings, the feed's declaration and the ranked readings, by a fixed template. No model wrote it.
